# netbox_module_type_profile (Data Source)

Retrieves a single module type profile from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_module_type_profile" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the module type profile. At least one of `name` must be given.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the module type profile.
- `description` (String) A description of the module type profile.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the module type profile.
- `schema` (String) The schema of the module type profile.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
